The proof unfolds this definition and applies the generic Finsupp lemma `Finsupp.sum_add_index'`, with `add_mul` and `Finsupp.single_add` closing the side goals. That is a general homomorphism-style principle applied to a library-specific definition. The mathematical content is the additivity of a map the library defines itself, so this does not count as duplicating Mathlib. I searched the library for the definition of `depthDiv`.
